A potted plant stands near the couple, its leaves vibrant green. Above the gate counter, a clock shows the time clearly. A janitor in orange overalls mops the floor near the counter, pushing a bucket. The janitor looks at a spill on the tiles. A vending machine glows softly in the background, stocked with colorful drinks. A trash can sits next to the vending machine. There is no snow visible anywhere in the terminal.
